checks.title: Compute instance enables Shielded VM vTPM
checks.remediation: Review the collected setting and configure shieldedInstanceConfig.enableVtpm according to the intended security policy.

alternative.sql: SELECT row_id, CASE WHEN json_type(payload, '$') IS DISTINCT FROM 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$.collection_status'), 'collected') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty') OR coalesce(json_type(payload, '$._coverage'), 'OBJECT') <> 'OBJECT' OR json_type(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig') IS DISTINCT FROM 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig.collection_status'), 'collected') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty') OR coalesce(json_type(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig._coverage'), 'OBJECT') <> 'OBJECT' OR (json_type(payload, '$._coverage.shieldedInstanceConfig') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(payload, '$._coverage.shieldedInstanceConfig') <> 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$._coverage.shieldedInstanceConfig.status'), 'unknown') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty'))) OR (json_type(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig._coverage.enableVtpm') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig._coverage.enableVtpm') <> 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig._coverage.enableVtpm.status'), 'unknown') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty'))) OR coalesce(json_type(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig.enableVtpm'), 'NULL') NOT IN ('BOOLEAN') THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN json_extract_string(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig.enableVtpm') IN ('true') THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status, json_extract(payload, '$.shieldedInstanceConfig.enableVtpm') AS configured FROM facts ORDER BY row_id

alternative.sql: SELECT row_id, CASE WHEN json_type(payload, '$') IS DISTINCT FROM 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$.collection_status'), 'collected') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty') OR coalesce(json_type(payload, '$._coverage'), 'OBJECT') <> 'OBJECT' OR json_type(payload, '$.properties') IS DISTINCT FROM 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$.properties.collection_status'), 'collected') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty') OR coalesce(json_type(payload, '$.properties._coverage'), 'OBJECT') <> 'OBJECT' OR (json_type(payload, '$._coverage.properties') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(payload, '$._coverage.properties') <> 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$._coverage.properties.status'), 'unknown') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty'))) OR (json_type(payload, '$.properties._coverage.allowCrossTenantReplication') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(payload, '$.properties._coverage.allowCrossTenantReplication') <> 'OBJECT' OR coalesce(json_extract_string(payload, '$.properties._coverage.allowCrossTenantReplication.status'), 'unknown') NOT IN ('collected', 'empty'))) OR coalesce(json_type(payload, '$.properties.allowCrossTenantReplication'), 'NULL') NOT IN ('BOOLEAN') THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN json_extract_string(payload, '$.properties.allowCrossTenantReplication') IN ('false') THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status, json_extract(payload, '$.properties.allowCrossTenantReplication') AS configured FROM facts ORDER BY row_id
